title: Tool output combines browser-context markers with first-person policy language
description: Narrow marker-based exposure signal for the browser-metadata framing reported by Sublime.

classification.rationale: Possible forged context in retrieved content; genuine browser tools and research reproductions require disambiguation.

falsepositives: Original research, copied examples, or browser integration test data.
investigation: Determine whether the metadata came from an actual browser tool or was embedded in untrusted content.
